strings.subtitle: — Nu ɖiɖe wema —
strings.dnd_hint: (kavi hɛn wema ɖo awa e tɛnmɛ)
strings.dnd_unavailable: Hihɛn kpodo jojo kpo ɖi ǎ. Zán buton e ɖo gǔdó ɔ.
strings.ssd_warning:
Kpɔ́n! Ðó SSD, ali e nɔ wlán ɖó tá ɔ é nɔ̀ gbɛ́ ɖiɖe ǎ ɖó TRIM wú.
Plogramu e ɔ yí HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Wema "{name}" é ná wlán ɖó tá bo ná ɖiɖe.

Xɔ́n?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.error_cannot_read:
Nù kán byɔ́ wema ɔ ǎ:
{err}
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS ali ɖevo tɛnmɛ data (ADS) ɔ w'azɔ̀ ǎ.
• USN wemaxɔ́ ɔ ɖó zɔ̀ ǎ.
• Hɛn lɛ́ kpodo cloud sync kpo
  (OneDrive, atg.) w'azɔ̀ ǎ.
strings.status_full: Nu e ɖo xɔ́mɛ ɔ bǐ è wlán ɖó tá kpé ɖó zero. É ná kúnú ǎ — nuwlanwlan lɛ́ ná mɔ́ zero kɛ̀n.
strings.status_fast: Ta, sìn kpodo 4 MB lɛ́ kpo è wlán ɖó tá. E kpò ɔ è wlán ǎ, lo ɔ ɖó mɔ̀ ɔ wú, kúnú kpé ɖó nuwlanwlan consumer lɛ́ ɖi ǎ. Wema hwenu ɖé ɔ zán MƆ̀DE KPÉ.
strings.status_empty: Wema ɔ vɔ̌, wlán ɖó tá kpa ǎ. É ɖiɖe.
strings.error_permission: Kúnú yì wema ɔ kpɔ́n ǎ. É sixu ɖo hún ɖevo mɛ. Klǎ bo lɛ́ bɛ.
strings.error_not_found: Wema ɔ mɔ ǎ. É sixu ɖiɖe kpɔ́n.
strings.error_unknown: Nǔ gble e ma yí ǎ: {err}
strings.error_is_symlink: E ɔ nyí kɔnkɔn kancica. Kɔnkɔn lɛ́ kúnú ɖiɖe ǎ — wema e kɔn ɔ ná gbɛ̀.
strings.error_reparse: E ɔ nyí wema hwɛndo tɛntin (OneDrive kavi ɖevo). Data tɔn ɖo alɔkpa mɛ, ɖo disk mɛ ǎ — ɖo fi ɔ nǔ ɖé ɖo ǎ.
strings.error_not_file: E ɔ nyí wema ǎ (foldɛ kavi ɖevo). Jo wema ɖé.
strings.error_hardlinks: Wema e ɔ ɖó kɔnkɔn sìn ɖevo lɛ́ ({n} bǐ). Kɔnkɔn sìn lɛ́ ɖó ta ǎ — nyǐ bǐ sɔ̀. Nɛ è ná ɖiɖe ɖó ali e ɖo fi ɔ ɔ, data ná wlán ɖó tá bo klǎ ɖó 32 byte, lo ɔ e kpò ɔ ná mɔ̀ ɖó kɔnkɔn ɖevo lɛ́. Ðiɖe kɔnkɔn bǐ hwɛhwɛ.
strings.error_compressed:
Wema ɔ è kán, è zɛ̀n, kavi é yí hwi. Wlán ɖó tá ɖó zero é nɔ̀ gbɛ́ ɖiɖe nuwlanwlan xóxu lɛ́ ǎ ɖó NTFS nɔ̀ zán ali ɖevo wú.

Ðe akpǎ: kliku amɛsí → Nǔ tɔn → Hwɛhwɛ → ɖe tiki ɖo "Kán" kavi "Zɛ̀n" sí. É ɖyɔ̌ ɔ gɔ́ SHREDDER ɖevo.
